node.statement: Complementarity identity. For any primal optimum h and any reduced optimal hiddenness dual witness (lambda,alpha,beta), pairing h with the dual balance and using h(p_u)=0, sum_F lambda_f=1, and sum_i beta_i=t gives sum_F lambda_f*(h(p_f)-t) + sum_i alpha_i*h(p_i) + sum_i beta_i*(1-h(p_i)) = 0.
